Name: Naturally Valley
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Naturally Valley is a simple terrain recolour mod, it retouches the ground, grass and  cliffs and makes them less harsh on the eyes, while still maintaining the vibrance Stardew Valley is known for.


Things to note:
• No trees are recoloured, so get yourself Simple Foliage, Foliage Redone, Yri's Tree Overhaul or whatever else you like for trees. 
Trust me, these options are better than anything I can come up with, since I can't draw trees at all. [s]They STILL  scare me and I STILL  refuse to face my fears.

[/s]• You'll be starring at the ugly boulders during the first 5 days of spring near the mine and until summer, the cliff entrance to the bath house will also look ugly. I'm very sorry, but at least it's only temporarily. 


Compatibilty:
If you want to use this recolour with a mod that uses DNT Tilesheets (for example Reimagined 3), you need to replace the assets in the Vanilla DNT Folder with my edit of them. You'll find this edit in the files down below!

Should be compatible with RSV and East Scarp. SVE will have mismatched tiles.

Downloads.Description: Replace the assets in the DNT Vanilla Folder.
Huge thanks to squigglylines for fixing the missing tiles! <3
